# brewcode

> Claude Code plugin suite (4 plugins, 27 skills, 9 agents) and two mods: `++r`-style prompt placeholders and plan-mode effort.

Requirement: the mods need Claude Code 2.1.301 or newer. Run `claude --version`; below that run `claude update`.

## Docs

- [Install or update, written for an LLM](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kochetkov-ma/claude-brewcode/main/UPDATE.md): exact commands for a first install and for an update, what to tell the user after.
- [Recommended flow](https://doc-claude.brewcode.app/recommended-flow/): install once, set up each project, work a task with `++m`, review with `++r`, share.
- [Prompt placeholders mod](https://doc-claude.brewcode.app/mods/placeholders/): `++r`, `++m`, `+++` and your own, with `/placeholders`.
- [Console recording of placeholders](https://brewcode.app/mods/placeholders.gif): `++` typeahead, the text shown before Enter, `/placeholders`.
- [Getting started](https://doc-claude.brewcode.app/getting-started/): what the suite contains.
- [Installation](https://doc-claude.brewcode.app/installation/): requirements, install methods, verifying, mods.
- [Approaches](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kochetkov-ma/claude-brewcode/main/APPROACHES.md): every hook, agent and injection the suite installs.
